description: Test utility functions for HTTP/2 frame structures, including randomization and header property checks.

methods.name: Randomize
methods.description: Functions to randomize various HTTP/2 frame fields using a random number generator.

methods.name: ScrubFlagsOfHeader
methods.description: Removes invalid flags from an HTTP/2 frame header based on frame type.

methods.name: FrameIsPadded
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP/2 frame is padded based on its header.

methods.name: FrameHasPriority
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP/2 frame has priority information.

methods.name: FrameCanHavePayload
methods.description: Determines if an HTTP/2 frame can have a payload.

methods.name: FrameCanHaveHpackPayload
methods.description: Determines if an HTTP/2 frame can have an HPACK payload.
